name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
env:
  GO_VERSION: "1.26"
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
      - name: Test
        run: go test -p 8 ./...
      - run: |
          go vet ./...
          go tool golangci-lint run
        shell: bash
      - if: failure()
        run: echo "failed" && exit 1
